Plant.Name: Basil (Genovese / sweet basil, Ocimum basilicum)
Plant.CareNotes: Prefers evenly moist soil but is very prone to root rot and fungal disease from overwatering — this is the most common way to kill basil at home. Do not water reflexively off a single low-moisture reading; let the topsoil dry slightly between waterings, and prefer several light waterings over one heavy soak. Ideal temperature is 20-30C; growth slows below ~15C, and cold below ~10C can blacken and damage leaves. Needs strong light, roughly 6+ hours of bright/direct-equivalent light daily — a low Lux trend suggests insufficient light, which causes weak, leggy growth that watering or cooling cannot fix (note this in Reason if relevant, it is not a pump/fan issue). Moderate humidity is fine, but wet soil combined with poor airflow encourages fungal disease (e.g. downy mildew), so avoid keeping the soil constantly saturated.
